limit.description: Maximum rows; `0` means the core default.

after.description:
Pagination cursor: return only rows older than this event. Pass the
last id of the previous page. Ids are ULIDs, so "older" is "sorts
before".

check_drift.description:
Compare live fingerprints with the recorded ones and fill `drift`.
Costs one read per touched path; `false` leaves `Unchecked`.

SkillName.description:
Lexical skill name: the directory name that holds `SKILL.md`.

Invariant: two deployments with the same `SkillName` are the same skill,
even when their bytes differ. A symlink alias with another name is another
skill.

EventId.description:
History event id (ULID string).

Invariant: lexical order equals creation order inside one store.
